decisions.reason: The devore decoration line sits close to the firm's established decorative fabric expertise, so it can read market feedback and refine the variants, although design-led collection rotation adds some risk of replacement after three years.
The transparent burnout fabric builds directly on the firm's existing decorative know-how, which lets it assimilate customer feedback and adjust the several models rather than abandon the line.
As a single fashion-oriented burnout article it is more exposed to collection turnover, but its closeness to the core offer still favours keeping it.
The velour-like upholstery fabric extends the firm's established upholstery range, where its related knowledge and stocked supply model support continued improvement and reorder continuity.
The flame-retardant plain inbetween is a functional staple that builds on existing competence and serves dependable reorder demand from retail and contract buyers, so dropping it is unlikely.
The satin-sheen polyester lining is a basic complement to the firm's made-to-measure sewing and decoration range, and it is easy to sustain with existing knowledge and warehouse capabilities.
